settings.heading: Q2: How does Venustas heated apparel change your lifestyle?
settings.body: C: It definitely is a must on a daily basis! So easy to carry anywhere (outdoor activities, fires in the evening with friends, others). No need to bring many blankets anymore!

settings.heading: Q3: Which part most appealing to you about Venustas?
settings.body: C: Definitely the Women's Heated Vest. I can wear it from summer to winter time! It suits on a hoodie if needed and is perfect for chilly summer nights.

settings.heading: Q4: How do you feel about Venustas heated apparel?
settings.body: C: Very comfortable, stylish, and always ready to go whatever the weather! I also really appreciate the staff, very professional and nice people.

settings.heading: Q5: The reason to be our V+ Master.
settings.body: C: I do fit with your brand image as I am an active person and like to travel. Outdoor activities are my favorite! I also have a dog, with leads me to walk a lot, all year long. A passion of mine is also photography (not an expert, but appreciate artistic creations/scenarios)
